name: agent-worksystem-builder
description: Build complete intelligent systems through continuous requirements grill, adaptive exploration and evidence-backed software and intelligence orchestration.

interface.longDescription: A native Codex coordinator composes five focused Skills for continuous requirements grill, adaptive exploration, architecture and intelligence configuration, implementation, and independent verification. Targets choose ordinary software architecture and optional interactive/noninteractive intelligence without mandatory AWB DAG or business storage. Versioned contracts, recoverable construction state, general verifiers and three standalone examples are implemented. Python 3.11+; MCP is optional. This 0.2 candidate is not release-qualified: gpt-6-sol/max actual access passed in both modes; 120 matched builds and human acceptance remain gates.
defaultPrompt: Grill my requirements, explore options and build the complete intelligent system I need.
设计整体软件架构和智能层，持续探索、实现、核验并保留决策。

publication.release_notes: Unreleased 0.2 candidate restores broad intelligent-system construction, adds exploration and versioned architecture/intelligence contracts, dual-mode Codex adapters, general verification and whole-goal coverage. Existing CLI/MCP remain compatible; alpha.4 assets unchanged. Qualification and official approval are separate pending gates.

zh-CN.subtitle: 自动编排与实现完整智能系统
zh-CN.description: 通过持续需求 grill、自适应探索与评估—创造—验证—决策循环，构筑用户需要的完整系统；整体软件架构与可选交互、非交互智能层分别设计。新增探索模块、版本化契约和通用核验。0.2 为未发布候选，gpt-6-sol/max 双模式真实访问已通过；120 次对照构筑和人工试用仍待验收。
